o.text: Borrowed from Classical Persian اهل علم (ahl-i 'ilm).
From *siyil, from *sigil, ultimately from Proto-Turkic *sögil. For other cases with initial /s/~/z/ variation, see zəngin, zopa.
From Proto-Turkic *yẹŋ- (“to win”). Cognate with Turkish yenmek and Kazakh жену (jenüw).
